title: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder 5.5 X 6 X 5 Solid Brass | Vanity Top Accessories | Allied Brass
description:
Need a place for toilet paper but don’t have wall space? This vanity top toilet tissue holder is a countertop toilet paper holder (also called a toilet tissue holder or toilet roll holder) designed to sit on the vanity top so a roll stays close at hand.

Highlights
- Conserve wall space in a small bathroom or powder room with a vanity-top, counter-set design
- Keep toilet tissue accessible next to the sink for guests and daily routines
- Built for lasting use with solid brass construction and brass construction throughout
- Coordinate with the Vanity Top Accessories collection for a consistent, transitional bathroom hardware look
- Offered in multiple designer finish options to match versatile bath accessories across the room

Specs & Details
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 5.5 x 6 x 5 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 12 x 10 x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 5 lbs
- Installation style: vanity top / countertop placement (not wall-mounted, not wall mount, not wall hanging)
- Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembled in the USA
